ActionSpec.description: Serializable project-side equivalent of Concordia's ActionSpec.
ActionSpec.title: ActionSpec

known_by.description: Must be empty when visibility is public. For private or secret facts, list every knowing character id exactly once.
known_by.title: Known By

visibility.description: Use public for facts known to everyone. Use private or secret only when knowledge is restricted to specific characters.
visibility.title: Visibility

ManuscriptContextManifest.description: Small durable audit record; it never stores prompt or fact bodies.
ManuscriptContextManifest.title: ManuscriptContextManifest

ManuscriptSourceCandidate.description: A bounded, branch-local range that can be frozen as manuscript input.
ManuscriptSourceCandidate.title: ManuscriptSourceCandidate

ManuscriptSourceManifest.description: Immutable lineage chosen before the writer is called.
ManuscriptSourceManifest.title: ManuscriptSourceManifest

ProjectionTask.description: A rebuildable view update derived from one committed simulation boundary.
ProjectionTask.title: ProjectionTask

PromotionDecision.description: Durable promotion result after local candidate binding.
PromotionDecision.title: PromotionDecision

ResolvedEvent.description: Lightweight projection of a Game Master world event.
ResolvedEvent.title: ResolvedEvent

ResolvedTurn.description: Project-side projection of one Engine step.
ResolvedTurn.title: ResolvedTurn

SimulationLogRecord.description: One immutable node in the durable cognitive-history chain.
SimulationLogRecord.title: SimulationLogRecord

StateEffect.description: Optional machine projection; natural-language events remain authoritative.
StateEffect.title: StateEffect

known_fact_ids.description: Only private or secret fact ids belong here. A fact id must appear exactly for the characters listed in that fact's known_by array; never include public fact ids.
known_fact_ids.title: Known Fact Ids

SubmissionDraft.description: Non-canonical setting package assembled during submission discussion.
SubmissionDraft.title: SubmissionDraft

WorldClock.description: A world-owned deadline that may deterministically trigger initiative.
WorldClock.title: WorldClock
